metadata.purpose: Synthetic alias and structural speaker diagnostics

identity_expectations.full_name: same full speaker name should be one structural group
identity_expectations.titled_name: title plus name remains a person candidate
identity_expectations.initial: initial forms are review evidence unless explicitly listed
identity_expectations.short_first_name: short forms are not inferred identity merges
identity_expectations.nickname: nicknames require an explicit alias entry
identity_expectations.shared_surname: same surname for two people stays ambiguous
identity_expectations.benign_collision: common process nouns are not names

segments.text: Dr. Eva Keller: Die Prüfung ist abgeschlossen.
A. Beispiel und Anna sprechen kurz.
Frau Müller beginnt, Herr Müller antwortet.
MÜLLER prüft die Datei; müller bleibt unklar.
Der Kunde prüft den Vorgang. Die Bank bleibt unverändert.
